metric_definitions.action_share: Share of recorded on-ball actions; NOT possession time.
metric_definitions.territory_share: Share of both teams' on-ball actions starting at x >= 66.667 in their attacking coordinates.
metric_definitions.progressive_pass_rate: Completed passes gaining at least 10 normalized x units / all attempted passes.
metric_definitions.shot_share: Share of shots plus goals; goal events must not duplicate shot events.
metric_definitions.tci: Provisional weighted event Tactical Control Index, 0 to 100; not a validated model.
metric_definitions.network_density: Distinct completed directed pass edges / n(n-1), using observed passer/receiver nodes.
metric_definitions.hub_share: Largest share of completed passes received by one player.
metric_definitions.pressure_per100: Pressure events / opponent pass attempts, multiplied by 100; NOT PPDA.
metric_definitions.spatial_control: Fraction of grid points nearest to this team, averaged across full snapshots; NOT calibrated pitch control.
metric_definitions.central_control: Nearest-player control in central attacking third: x >= 66.667, y in [33.333,66.667].
metric_definitions.defensive_width_m: Mean lateral range of outfield players in meters across snapshots; goalkeeper excluded by nearest-own-goal heuristic.
metric_definitions.defensive_depth_m: Mean longitudinal range of outfield players in meters across snapshots; goalkeeper excluded by nearest-own-goal heuristic.

analysis.research_warning: Offline rules are workflow scaffolding, not a test of LLM superiority. Structured numerical verification is not a semantic or causal-validity guarantee.

limitations: Synthetic matches demonstrate software behavior only; they cannot establish research findings.
Action share is not time-based possession. TCI is an unvalidated event proxy.
Tracking estimates use nearest-player geometry, not calibrated arrival-time pitch control.
No confidence intervals are computed: adjacent observations are dependent.
No causal claims, inferred fatigue, or passing-lane availability are supported.
Automatic checks measure structural/numeric faithfulness; experts must assess tactical validity.
